market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain range-bound to slightly lower as RBA rate fears dominate. Tech strength from Wall Street provides partial offset but cannot overcome rate-driven discounting. Oil/diesel volatility adds noise. Expect 2-3% downside risk in rate-sensitive sectors.
market_outlook.long_term: Structural headwinds from iron ore demand shift, housing correction, and fiscal tightening suggest cautious 6-12 month outlook. Gold/rare earths and energy offer relative outperformance. Tech and data centre themes provide growth pockets. RBA cycle peak likely within 2-3 quarters.
